component.name: Robrix
component.summary: Powerful Matrix chat with dockable tabs for many rooms at once

description.p: Robrix is a new, powerful Matrix client that offers the full experience of a desktop chat app, and beyond, without sacrificing performance or functionality.

We even bring some cool new features to the world of Matrix, like our customizable dockable tabs layout that lets you view and interact with multiple rooms or threads simultaneously. This looks just like your favorite multi-tab web browser or programming IDE. Now you can keep tabs on as many conversations as you want, all at once, and Robrix won't jump or jerk the view around while you scroll through your rooms.

Robrix adapts to any screen size, but doesn't limit what you can do. We wrote it from scratch in Rust to provide the same functionality and quality on all platforms, thanks to the Makepad UI toolkit and the Robius framework, which we also wrote from scratch. So you can look forward to the same sleek design, fast startup, and fluid experience on any device, even when scrolling through dozens of rooms with thousands of messages, and move between Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS without giving up any features or learning a new app UI.

Matrix is an open protocol for secure, decentralized chat and other communication, built with privacy at its core. Instead of trusting one company with all of your messages, you create an account on a homeserver of your choice, run by a community, an employer, a government, or even yourself, and talk to anyone on any other homeserver across the world. Basically, it's like email, but fully encrypted and real-time. No ads, no analytics, no data brokers.
Robrix supports nearly all the main Matrix client features you'd expect:

ul.li: End-to-end encryption and verification for encrypted chat across public, private, and DM rooms
Fast login and room updates via native sliding sync
Room timelines with richly-formatted text content, images, and link previews
Spaces: explore and join rooms and sub-spaces
Editing messages, without losing your draft
Replies: inline previews, and sending replies
Rooms: joining and leaving, sending and receiving invites, knocking
Offline mode with a persistent local event cache
Login to supported homeservers via SSO or username and password

description.p: Robrix is free and open source. Contributions and issues are welcome.
Robrix is just getting started and is under active development. Not all features are complete yet, such as admin tools for kicking and banning users, message search, and media upload and playback.
